newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bellwether stocks fall in kerb.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bellwether stocks fall in kerb.

text.p: Pakistan's blue-chip stocks PTCL and Hubco fell in the kerb market on Wednesday ahead of a keenly-awaited Supreme Court decision on ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto's plea for reinstatement, dealers said.
PTCL was quoted at 31.70 rupees before the start of trading at the Karachi bourse, against Tuesday's high of 33.10. HUBCO traded at 37.75 compared to its 39.25 high, one dealer said.
The Supreme Court was expected to announce its ruling after the end of normal trading at 0800 GMT. The 100-share index fell 1.32 points to 1,500.84 after rising to 1,522.61 on Tuesday.
